Tour 2026Aztec Theater Learn MoreSee All EventsAdd Event Local NewsNationwide recall for eye drops sold at multiple San Antonio stores, including H-E-B The Food and Drug Administration designated the action a Class II recall.Samuel Rocha IV, Newsroom TraineePublished: April 3, 2026 at 4:45 PMH-E-B (KSAT 12 News)66SAN ANTONIO – More than 3 million eye drop containers sold nationwide, including some at San Antonio-area H-E-B stores, have been recalled by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).The FDA designated the action as a “Class II recall” on March 31, which is defined as “temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences or where the probability of serious adverse health consequences is remote,” according to their website.Recommended VideosRecommended Videos1/20SAPD FDA, is due to “lack of assurance of sterility.”K.C. Pharmaceuticals, Inc, a California-based company, sold the eye drop solution under numerous names to stores nationwide such as H-E-B, Walgreens, Walmart and CVS. The recalled H-E-B-branded products include:H-E-B A.C. Eye DropsH-E-B Lubricant Eye DropsH‑E‑B Original Eye DropsThe full list of product names, expiration dates and specific stores can be found on the FDA report.More recent news coverage on KSAT: Hidden in plain sight: These quiet protectors hold back floodwaters in San AntonioBexar County ME’s Office identifies man killed in suspected East Side drive-by shootingCommunity members fill downtown San Antonio streets for Passion Play on Good FridayCopyright 2026 by KSAT - All rights reserved.About the AuthorSamuel Rocha IVSamuel Rocha joined KSAT as a Newsroom Trainee in the spring of 2026.
